description: Airlines face penalties for carrying passengers refused entry, so ground staff verify visas, onward tickets and sometimes funds - applying a standard that varies by route and by passport.
energy_note: Questioned at check-in, before any border.

aspect: EXAMPLE - refused departure from their own country
description: In 2020 Nigeria's Immigration Service refused departure to 58 London-bound Nigerian doctors at Lagos airport; the chartered flight was meant to carry 42 for training and 58 presented, of whom only two held UK visas.
energy_note: Stopped from leaving, by your own immigration service.

aspect: Denied boarding is worse than denied entry
description: A refusal at the gate means the ticket is used, the visa clock runs, and the traveller is in their own country with no incident to appeal and no record anyone will produce.
energy_note: Refused by an airline, with nothing to appeal.

aspect: SCENARIO - the funds question at check-in
description: Ground staff ask how much money she is carrying and where she is staying. The passenger behind her, going to the same city, is asked nothing. Both have valid visas. The airline is applying its own risk assessment and is entitled to.
energy_note: Asked at the desk what the border would have asked.
